summary:
Project Title: AI-Based Wireless Power Transfer System Using MATLAB Simulink
Project Description:
Developed a simulation-based project using MATLAB Simulink that integrates Artificial Intelligence (AI) with a wireless power transfer system. The model uses a simulated butterfly input, an AI processing unit, and a Transmitter (TX) and Receiver (RX) system to demonstrate wireless energy transmission.
The system includes coil-based power transfer and a battery-motor section to represent the energy utilization process.
Key Technologies & Concepts:
MATLAB Simulink
Artificial Intelligence (AI)
Wireless Power Transfer (WPT)
Transmitter and Receiver (TX & RX)
Battery and Motor Integration
System Simulation and Modelling
Key Learning Outcomes:
Understanding AI-based system integration.
Learning wireless power transmission concepts.
Designing and analysing simulation models.
Understanding transmitter and receiver operations.
This project helped strengthen my knowledge of AI integration, simulation techniques, and wireless power transfer technology.
